events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday, born in Akron, Ohio on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her influence on rock music with The Pretenders is undeniable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday, having been born in Manchester on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger after all these years.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring his iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine 55th
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us the timeless 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly today as it did in 1971.

events.title: The first iPod was released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? It's 25 years since Apple unleashed the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 64 years of 007 since 'Dr. No' first hit cinemas. Which Bond is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born in Liverpool on October 9, 1940, and would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon 86th Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotel chaos, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, universally known as the 'White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. A true journey through their diverse genius.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly stretched the boundaries of pop music.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his untimely passing. His legacy of peace and powerful music lives on.
